learning.why: Teacher ne whiteboard pe simple drawing dikhayi jis mein 'grown' aur 'eaten' ke beech ka raasta clear ho raha hai, aur mujhe doori ka concept local spinach se compare karne ka mauka mila.

end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to home or shop.
Connected greater distance with more fuel use and pollution, and less freshness.
Compared local spinach with apples from Shimla; identified local food as fresher.
Explained that refrigerated transport uses fuel.
Initially chose 80 km over 10 km as the shorter journey, then selected 10 km after the comparison was revisited.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and comparing foods by distance, fuel, pollution, and freshness. They used examples such as local spinach, apples from Shimla, and refrigerated strawberry transport. There was one mix-up when comparing 80 km and 10 km; this was corrected later by choosing the 10 km source. At home, ask them to compare two foods and say which travelled farther and why that matters.
